name: Swift Witchcraft
summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, and once per Long Rest cast a spell with a 1-minute casting time as an action.

benefits.name: Swift Invocation
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, use an action to cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 minute.
benefits.text: You can use an action to cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 minute. Once you do so you can't do it again until you finish a Long Rest.

prerequisites.text: Level 4 or higher, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
